title: Agent-ENV payload types
description: The `payload` of a `type: message` envelope. Agent->ENV: action, action_batch. ENV->agent: outcome, turn_start, game_end_notification.

requestId.description: Correlation key. An int or a string; the ENV echoes it back byte-for-byte in the matching outcome. Because JSON layers may render an int as a string, agents should compare ids as strings. Keep ints under 2**53.

action.description: Verb name. The legal set for a match comes from the register_agent_info reply, not from this schema.

actionBatch.title: action_batch (agent -> ENV)
actionBatch.description: Several actions in one message. The ENV replies with a single outcome carrying the batch id.

outcome.description: The result body. When `outcome_type` is "str" this is a JSON-encoded string that the agent must decode.

outcome_type.description: "str" means `outcome` is a JSON string rather than an object.

outcomeBody.title: Decoded outcome body
outcomeBody.description: The shape inside `outcome` once decoded. Failures always carry `success: false`; `error_code` is one of the codes in error_codes.schema.json.

turnStart.title: turn_start (ENV -> agent, unsolicited)
turnStart.description: Turn-based mode only. Resent until the agent replies with a turn_start_ack action, or until it sends any other action.

gameEndNotification.title: game_end_notification (ENV -> agent, unsolicited)
gameEndNotification.description: The match is over. The agent should report stats and stop acting.
